title: Interactive capacity quickstart fragments: scenario-based estimator & autoscale preview
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Design a set of lightweight, reusable onboarding art assets and interactive UI fragments for the Dedicated capacity quickstart flow. The goal is a progressive, scenario-driven experience that helps teams choose an initial capacity profile and autoscale policy by showing expected latency, throughput, and cost trade-offs. Deliverables: (1) an interactive throughput estimator card (slider + presets) with real-time KPI sparklines, (2) autoscale policy preview frames (3 breakpoint states: idle, steady traffic, burst) and micro-animations that illustrate scaling behavior, (3) compact SLA comparison strip that visualizes p50/p95 latency bands against SLA tiers and fallback behavior, and (4) a small set of annotated screenshots and copy for the docs quickstart and release notes.
acceptance_criteria: Estimator card UI exists as Figma components with tokenized color/spacing and three presets (Startup, Production, Burst)
Estimator updates at least three KPIs in real-time: p50 token latency, throughput (req/s), estimated monthly cost — numbers driven by seeded model profiles
Autoscale preview includes 3 animation frames and an overlay showing how cache and batching affect cost/latency
SLA strip compares two product tiers and documents automatic fallback (model variant) behavior in copy
Exportable PNG and SVG assets for docs and release notes plus annotated screenshots for Console UI
Design handoff contains clear spec tokens, animation timing, and accessibility notes (contrast + motion reduced versions)
tasks: Draft component wireframes and scenario flows (Sofia)
Seed realistic KPI values with PM/Research and generate sample datasets (PM + Eng)
Create Figma components, variants, and export slices (Aisha)
Review with PM, Eng, and DX for edge cases (latency spikes, cold start)
Prepare assets and microcopy for docs team and release notes
Handoff to front-end for prototype integration (include animation specs and fallbacks)
